chunks: I saw Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام leveling the pebbles at the place of his prostration between the two prostrations.

key_terms.بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ: during the interval between the two prostrations
key_terms.مَوْضِعِ سُجُودِهِ: the place where he performed sajdah
key_terms.يُونُسُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ: the narrator reporting what he witnessed

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to level the pebbles in the place of sajdah between the two prostrations?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū ʿAbdillāh Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام would level the pebbles where he placed his forehead in sajdah between the two prostrations. It reflects a practical aspect of salat and is relevant to rulings and etiquette concerning the place of prostration.
